title: SLEM: Spectrum-Aware Latent Expert Merging
abstract: arXiv:2610.16484v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale model capacity efficiently by activating only a small subset of experts for each input, while still requiring all parameters to be stored in memory, resulting in substantial memory overhead. Expert merging techniques have recently emerged as a promising compression paradigm that reduces this overhead by consolidating multiple experts into a smaller set. However, existing approaches have two key limitations: (i) direct convex interpolation in parameter space is not generally guaranteed to yield meaningful interpolation of expert functions; and (ii) estimating expert similarity or merging coefficients often relies on calibration data, introducing dependence on the calibration distribution. To address these limitations, we propose Spectrum-Aware Latent Expert Merging (SLEM), a calibration-free expert merging framework that occurs in a structured latent representation of expert weights using a VAE. translated_title: SLEM：频谱感知的潜在专家合并
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型通过为每个输入仅激活一小部分专家来高效扩展模型容量，但仍需将所有参数存储在内存中，从而造成显著的内存开销。专家合并技术近来作为一种有前景的压缩范式出现，通过将多个专家合并为更小的集合来减少这一开销。然而，现有方法存在两个关键局限：（i）参数空间中的直接凸插值通常无法保证产生有意义的专家函数插值；（ii）估计专家相似度或合并系数往往依赖校准数据，从而引入对校准分布的依赖。为解决这些局限，我们提出了频谱感知的潜在专家合并（SLEM），这是一个免校准的专家合并框架，它在借助VAE获得的专家权重的结构化潜在表示中进行合并。SLE...
tldr: 提出SLEM，一种无需校准数据的专家合并框架，利用VAE在专家权重的结构化潜在表示中进行合并，克服了参数空间直接凸插值缺乏意义以及依赖校准分布两大局限。
en_tdlr: SLEM is a calibration-free expert merging framework that merges experts within a structured latent representation of expert weights using a VAE, overcoming the limitations of meaningless convex interpolation in parameter space and dependence on calibration distributions.
